say:9:1511256008:1.female: No... of course, it's not that simple.

say:10:1511256009:1.text: The cruel mechanics of this spell are clear... One of us must remain on the other side of this portal.
say:10:1511256009:1.source_cn: 我和您之间，必须有一个人……在这道时空乱流的另一头。
say:10:1511256009:1.male: The cruel mechanics of this spell are clear... One of us must remain on the other side of this portal.
say:10:1511256009:1.female: The cruel mechanics of this spell are clear... One of us must remain on the other side of this portal.

say:11:1511256010:1.text: In other words... <style="highlight">I must send you back to the future.</style>
say:11:1511256010:1.male: In other words... <style="highlight">I must send you back to the future.</style>
say:11:1511256010:1.female: In other words... <style="highlight">I must send you back to the future.</style>

say:14:1511256013:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, after you returned to the future thirteen years ago, I dedicated my studies entirely to the mysteries of time magic. I sought to understand the power that took you from us.
say:14:1511256013:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, after you returned to the future thirteen years ago, I dedicated my studies entirely to the mysteries of time magic. I sought to understand the power that took you from us.
say:14:1511256013:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, after you returned to the future thirteen years ago, I dedicated my studies entirely to the mysteries of time magic. I sought to understand the power that took you from us.

say:15:1511256014:1.text: I had always dreamed that this magic would one day carry me to the future, so our paths might converge again...
say:15:1511256014:1.source_cn: 我原本期待，也许有一天能够前往未来，与您重逢……
say:15:1511256014:1.male: I had always dreamed that this magic would one day carry me to the future, so our paths might converge again...
say:15:1511256014:1.female: I had always dreamed that this magic would one day carry me to the future, so our paths might converge again...

say:16:1511256015:1.text: I never imagined its true purpose was not a reunion, but to force us into a second farewell.
say:16:1511256015:1.source_cn: 但没想到，这魔法要带来的不是重逢，而是再一次离别。
say:16:1511256015:1.male: I never imagined its true purpose was not a reunion, but to force us into a second farewell.

say:18:1511256016:1.male: Time magic is not as simple as you think.
say:18:1511256016:1.female: Time magic is not as simple as you think.

say:22:1511256019:1.text: No matter the choice I make, regret will surely follow. But like Tilaya and the others, I cannot allow the pain of this moment to blind me to the possibilities of the future.

say:23:1511256020:1.source_cn: 您……答应过我，不告知我的未来，让我做出自己的选择。

say:25:1511256021:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>... You have to return to your own time.

say:26:1511256022:1.text: Those echoes... they ripple from your own time. So many voices are calling for you. It reminds me... of my own voice, calling out for you all those years ago.
say:26:1511256022:1.source_cn: 那些回声……来自您所属时空的回声，有许多人在呼唤您的名...

choice:20:1:2.text: Ah, the choice may be final this time.

choice:17:0:1.female: It's okay. You can come find me again.

choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 为什么这么悲伤？我们还能再见！

choice:13:0:1.text: It seems we're destined to part ways.
choice:13:0:1.male: It seems we're destined to part ways.
choice:13:0:1.female: It seems we're destined to part ways.

choice:13:1:2.female: Then I'll stay two more days...
